# Functional Requirements

## FR-1: Galaxy Map and Star Systems

Status: draft

The game shall present a galaxy containing at least 8 named star systems, each with one station. The player shall be able to view a galaxy map showing available systems and select a destination for hyperspace travel.

## FR-2: Commodity Trading Market

Status: draft

The game shall provide a commodity market at each station where the player can buy and sell commodities. Prices shall vary per system so that profitable trade routes exist between systems. The player shall not be able to buy more than their remaining cargo capacity or spend more credits than they hold.

## FR-3: Hyperspace Travel

Status: draft

The player shall be able to initiate a hyperspace jump from the current system to a selected destination system. Each jump shall consume fuel. The player shall not be able to jump if insufficient fuel remains.

## FR-4: Pirate Encounters

Status: draft

Each hyperspace jump shall carry a risk of a pirate encounter. When a pirate is encountered, the player enters combat.

## FR-5: Ship-to-Ship Combat

Status: draft

The player shall engage in arcade-style ship-to-ship combat against AI-controlled pirates using lasers. The player shall be able to fight or flee from combat. Combat resolution shall determine damage to shields and hull for both the player and the pirate.

## FR-6: Ship Upgrades

Status: draft

The player shall be able to purchase ship upgrades at stations: increased cargo capacity, improved laser, improved shields, and increased fuel tank. Upgrades shall cost credits and take effect immediately.

## FR-7: Save and Load

Status: draft

The player shall be able to save the current game state and reload a previously saved game state in a subsequent session. All persistent game data (credits, cargo, ship stats, position, rating) shall be preserved.

## FR-8: Server Health Endpoint

Status: draft

The server shall expose a /healthz endpoint that returns a healthy status response.

## FR-9: Ship HUD

Status: draft

The game shall display a heads-up display showing the player's current shields, fuel level, cargo contents, and credit balance.

## FR-10: Elite Rating Progression

Status: draft

The game shall track and display an Elite combat rating based on the player's accumulated profit and combat kills.
